title: Rudrāṣṭakam
author: Goswami Tulsidas
intro: Eight verses to Shiva as Rudra, from the Uttarakāṇḍa of Tulsidas's Rāmcharitmānas (16th century), followed by a closing verse. Like the Nirvāṇa Ṣaṭkam, it uses the Bhujaṅgaprayāta meter (◡ — — four times per line), which gives it its flowing, chant-like rhythm.
note: The first eight verses are in Bhujaṅgaprayāta; the closing verse is in Anuṣṭubh. Tulsidas's Sanskrit is lightly Hindi-flavoured, and one line (verse 7) bends the meter slightly.
